findings: SCOPE OF APPROVAL: This approval covers only dependency bindings, source fidelity, effective conditions and wording selections, checked by reading the 29 old payloads against the current code. It does not approve the new batch, the 56 new payloads or exports, the global expanded_order/source_order/documentary_instructions/navigation hash values, or any source-image proof.

RULES MATCH THE CODE: The docstring rules match realizations.py:46-88. (a) Literal, resolved and corrected hashes are computed only from the owner's own segment, settings and corrections (review_payloads lines 426-439). (b) attesting_controls skips only `unit is owner` and units that reuse the language. It walks the segments returned first by prepare_documents, so canonical_home contexts and canonical_whole collapses show up as canonical pointers. It matches callers by intersecting {target} plus the identities of the resolved range segments with selected_ids minus None. (c) It records each caller's own segment controls and unit controls, never the caller's wording. So callers that choose different wording are still bound. Examples: musaf_repetition_yimlokh (abbreviated name / 'will reign') appears in rh_vetimlokh, which uses the plene name / 'shall reign'; musaf_repetition_gevurot_open (forever / falling_healing) appears in rh_gevurot, which uses for_ever / falling_and_healing.

OWNER EXCLUSION IS SAFE: Leaving out the owner loses no controls. A canonical_home owner cannot carry unit controls or non-plain segment keys (prepare_documents lines 458-464). A canonical_parts owner is restricted by validate_pure_parts. A plain corresp host has no call site of its own. So when the context occurrences of rh_gevurot, rh_vetimlokh, rh_qadosh_attah, rh_uvekhen_* and repetition_veattah_qadosh are excluded from their own lists, nothing is dropped.

REDIRECTED ORIGINAL IS INCLUDED: amidah_qedushah/he is a redirected original source occurrence. Its owner is the pure library qedushah_shared_parts, and amidah_qedushah lists itself as a caller at segment indexes 1/3/4/6, matching raw segment order with the unit conditions repetition+minyan and the rashi instruction. musaf_repetition_qadosh, musaf_repetition_barukh_kevod, musaf_repetition_uvedivrei and musaf_repetition_ledor_vador are each bound alongside it, consistent with the library's variant printings s238/s240/s246 (p.109/110/113).

REPEATED RECITATIONS NOT TREATED AS CANONICAL IDENTITY: amidah_qedushah segment 5 (corresp amidah/qedushah/yimlokh, a new identity printed with יְיָ) is correctly not a caller of bible:psalms/146/10. The callers of psalms/146/10 are exactly musaf_qedushah_yimlokh (speaker קו״ח, same snapshot in rh_vetimlokh/he and musaf_repetition_yimlokh/he), musaf_repetition_vetimlokh segment 1 and musaf_repetition_yimlokh. That count matches the three non-owner printings s226/s246/s252 (he) and s227/s247/s253 (en).

RANGE AND CANONICAL_WHOLE BINDING: In he, ranged callers cover each part through range identity. musaf_repetition_gevurot_open segment 0 (attah_gibbor..mekhalkel_chayyim) and musaf_repetition_gevurot_close segment 0 (mi_khamokha..mechayyeh_hametim) appear under every part target in rh_gevurot/he. In en, the split callers appear per segment (gevurot_open segment 0 and segment 1). musaf_repetition_qadosh_attah segment 0 appears under all three rh_qadosh_attah targets, including isaiah/5/16, which is identified through source_reference. The canonical_whole caller musaf_repetition_veattah_qadosh appears as an effective segment 0 under the text_corresp host repetition_veattah_qadosh, and its he resolved hash equals the owner's (9faf8ea7…). That is expected, because the he text is identical and only the en settings differ.

WORDING SELECTION AND FIDELITY: In every payload, literal_sha256 equals resolved_sha256. The single correction rh_pachdekha_hast ('has'→'hast') changes only corrected_sha256, and only in the en payload. Owner settings equal selection(), meaning reading index 0 is true. Every caller's wording_selection agrees with its printed text: forever/falling_healing; compassion_without_comma/and_thou_lord_with_comma; abbreviated_halleluyah_sheva/will_reign; art_enthroned; hu=false/let_holiness_ascend; and in amidah_qedushah kevod with maqaf, dor_plene, haaretz without meteg. Every payload's scans list matches the code: segment scans plus language-matched overlay printings plus additional_printings for that language.

EMPTY SOURCE_FIDELITY IS BY DESIGN: source_fidelity is empty for the literal-context home rh_uvekhen_ten_kavod (the context drops identities and creates no pointers), the pure library qedushah_shared_parts, and the plain host uvekhen_lekha_taaleh_qedushah. For these, the dependency on callers is carried only in the callers' own payloads. The caller payloads of musaf_repetition_uvekhen_ten_kavod are not in this pack.

INFORMATIONAL, ENCLOSING SCOPES: enclosing_scopes is empty everywhere in this pack. No caller here has segment-level conditions, and the only locally conditioned caller unit is amidah_qedushah. Any service-level conditioning of the musaf repetition units (their unit is {}) is bound only through the global expanded_order_sha256, not through attesting_controls.

NOT INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED: (1) I did not recompute any sha256, because only Read was allowed. (2) Caller lists are complete only as far as the evidence in this pack shows; I did not read the full readings file, so callers absent from every payload here could not be ruled out. (3) The claim that all 87 old payloads are computationally semantically unchanged was not verified. (4) The raw data of callers referenced but not themselves in this pack (musaf_repetition_qadosh, musaf_repetition_barukh_kevod, musaf_repetition_uvedivrei, musaf_repetition_ledor_vador, musaf_qedushah_yimlokh, musaf_repetition_vetimlokh, musaf_repetition_uvekhen_ten_pachdekha, musaf_repetition_uvekhen_tzaddiqim, musaf_repetition_qadosh_attah) was not seen. Their control snapshots are internally consistent wherever they repeat.

NON-BLOCKING, FOR THE SEPARATE ENCODING REVIEW: In qedushah_shared_parts, he barukh_kevod has source_reference_part (half-verse b) but en barukh_kevod has none. qadosh carries source_reference_part in both languages.
coverage_method: I used Read only. I read the whole of old-bindings-pack1.json (4273 lines) in six sequential chunks: lines 1-400, 400-1099, 1100-2099, 2100-3099, 3100-4099 and 4100-4273. That covers every line, including the closing bracket, and all 29 payloads in full: unit witnesses, source_fidelity, attesting_controls, settings, hashes, corrections and variants. I counted the 29 keys explicitly. I also read realizations.py lines 1-639: the expanded attesting_controls docstring and body at 46-88, prepare_unit, _range_segments, canonical_text, validate_occurrences, review_payloads at 403-450, prepare_documents at 453-519 and part of validate_generated. I read controlled-review-v5.json in full. I checked each payload by hand against the code paths: owner and caller resolution, segment indexes against raw segment order, settings against selection() and the printed text, scans derivation, and agreement of controls between payloads. No key is unread.
